## The heuristic

**Work anti-fit before fit.
**


_Why:_ Disqualifiers are cheap to evaluate, catch the most expensive outcomes, and take effect the day they are published. The positive profile only pays once targeting, routing and scoring have been rebuilt around it, which takes a quarter longer than anyone plans.
